about: The rebalance rehearsal's dry run, as a replay: the three-story rehearsal plan, re-sliced to extended with --dry-run. The run ends at the proposal and no write step is ever issued.

script.output:
SESSION MODEL: MATCH
The session runs the planning model the profile names.
```json
{"verdict": "MATCH", "profileLine": "standard: planning on the configured model"}
```

REBALANCE GATES: CLEAR
No build loop holds the plan and the auto-scheduler is off.
```json
{"root": "I100", "target": "extended", "dryRun": true}
```

PLAN STATE: PARTIAL
Read every level under I100, descriptions and comments.
```json
{"state": "PARTIAL", "doneOpenCounts": {"done": 0, "open": 3}, "orphans": [], "deferredContainer": null}
```

REBALANCE PARTITION: PARTITIONED 3-0
Three stories not started; none done, in progress or landed.
```json
{"notStarted": ["I103", "I104", "I105"], "untouchable": [], "current": "standard", "target": "extended"}
```

REBALANCE PROPOSAL: DRY RUN
The proposal was shown; a dry run writes nothing.
```json
{"proposal": [{"successor": "Stories one and two, merged", "absorbs": ["I103", "I104"]}, {"successor": "Story three, kept as it is", "absorbs": ["I105"]}]}
```
